title: Chatbots — Rule-Based to Neural to LLM Agents

questions.question: What does a slot-filling state machine do in a rule-based chatbot?
options: Picks the most fluent reply — and applies unchanged even when the lesson's stated preconditions fail, with no need to inspect intermediate results or test edge cases
Tracks which required parameters (date, destination, amount) are still missing and asks for them in sequence
questions.explanation: Slot filling iteratively collects the structured parameters a task handler needs.

questions.question: Why is retrieval-based chat resistant to hallucination?
options: It rejects all queries, with no need to inspect intermediate results or test edge cases
It returns a canned response from a curated set rather than generating new text
questions.explanation: Retrieval surfaces pre-written answers; no generation means no fabricated content.

questions.question: What defines an LLM agent loop versus a single-shot LLM call?
options: Use of greedy decoding, because one plausible output is sufficient production evidence, before defining the measurement, acceptance threshold, or rollback path
A controller that interleaves LLM calls with tool invocations until the model returns a final answer or the step budget is hit
questions.explanation: Agents add a plan-act-observe loop with tool calls and a termination condition.

questions.question: Why is hybrid routing (rules + retrieval + LLM agent) the 2026 production default?
options: It removes the need for evaluation, before defining the measurement, acceptance threshold, or rollback path — and applies unchanged even when the lesson's stated preconditions fail
No single architecture handles every request well; rules cover destructive actions, retrieval covers FAQ, agents handle ambiguous open-ended queries
questions.explanation: Hybrid systems use deterministic rules for risky actions and reserve LLM agents for open-ended queries.

questions.question: What is prompt injection?
options: Injecting tokens into embeddings — and applies unchanged even when the lesson's stated preconditions fail, with no need to inspect intermediate results or test edge cases
User-supplied (direct) or document-supplied (indirect) text that tries to override the system prompt or hijack the agent's behavior
questions.explanation: Prompt injection rewrites the agent's behavior via untrusted text in user input or tool outputs.

questions.question: Which OWASP Top 10 (LLM Apps 2025) risk is ranked LLM01?
options: Insecure deserialization, with no need to inspect intermediate results or test edge cases
questions.explanation: Prompt injection is LLM01 in the OWASP LLM Apps Top 10 (2025).
